Anya: Heads up 1 - creating a tiny PR to add an onprem "minimal ops" section: offline cert sync, ipv6 toggle, and two firewall fallbacks (nftables + iptables). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620
Rob: Nice. Can you include a short port matrix row for KMS <-> HSM and note the PKCS#11 port (5696) so support doesn't have to dig? Also include NTP (UDP 123) and a reminder to lock down SSH to maintenance hosts only.
Nima: Security: add note to set PKCS#11 socket perms (chmod 660) and run the HSM user without core dumps:
```
# disable core dumps for redwood user
echo 'redwood hard core 0' >> /etc/security/limits.conf
```
Anya: Adding that. Draft offline cert sync script (very small) below; will add a systemd timer example in PR as requested.
```
#!/bin/sh
# sync-certs.sh - copy bundled certs into installer path
set -e
remote=backup@example.local:/exports/redwood/certs.tar.gz
tmp=/tmp/redwood-certs.tar.gz
scp -o BatchMode=yes $remote $tmp
mkdir -p /etc/redwood/certs
tar -xzf $tmp -C /etc/redwood/certs
chown -R redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/certs
rm -f $tmp
```
Rob: Perfect. For firewall examples, keep them minimal. Suggest one nftables rule set and one iptables rule set for airgapped installers (just accept on admin and installer ports, drop rest).
Nima: Also mention conntrack tuning for high-concurrency installs (sysctl examples). Small snippet: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000`
